capability 2026-10-14 (session 56): `audio_device` - a fifth backed `set_device_control` control that routes audio output to the speaker or headset ("put it on speaker" / "switch to the headset"). `AudioDeviceMode` closed enum (SPEAKER/HEADSET; aliases speakerphone/loudspeaker/handsfree, earpiece/headphones/earphone/receiver) + `AudioDeviceController`/`AndroidAudioDeviceController` over the system `AudioManager` (API 31+ `setCommunicationDevice`/`getCommunicationDevice` with the speakerphone-flag fallback below S). Resolved *before* the a11y gate (system-audio backed, like torch/ringer_mode/dnd/brightness); the controller reads the active route back so success (`AUDIO_DEVICE`) is reported only on a confirmed change (`AUDIO_DEVICE_UNCHANGED` on an ignored request, `AUDIO_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE` when the service/output is absent, `AUDIO_DEVICE_PERMISSION`/`AUDIO_DEVICE_ERROR` otherwise). An unwired controller returns `AUDIO_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE` - never a fake success. Distinct from `adjust_volume` (how loud) and `ringer_mode`/`dnd` (whether the phone rings). Carried through `DeviceControlOp.AudioDevice` + `DeviceControl.resolve` (+`describeValue`/`keys`), `DeviceAutomation.execute` dispatch, `PlannerPromptBuilder.ACTION_CATALOG`, `ToolRegistry` description, `OmniAgentApplication` DI; validation is resolver-driven (unknown value -> Invalid). `AGENTS.md` documents the control and its self-evidencing rule.
